subject: empty files being created by rstan in tmp per chain per call to sampling/stan

messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: empty files being created by rstan in tmp per chain per call to sampling/stan
parts:
Hi all,

I run into this issue after upgrading to 2.8.0

In my code, I use stan_model (<file_name>, model_name = <some char>, verbose=F) to create/compile the stan model and hold it in a variable.

I would then call sampling (<var_name>, data=<some list>) to run the sampling.

Since upgrading to 2.8.0, i noticed a 0 size file in created in temp when I run sampling (with cores.=1 and I have also explicitly passed in open_progress=F, show_messages=F) for chain exectued. Most importantly, the connection to these zero length files did not get closed and my session would quickly run out of FD.

I wonder if anyone has any idea how I can fix this.
